dedupe_keys.name: municipal solid waste generation and collection projections by waste management planning region in azerbaijan 2022 2036

description: Nushaba Qadimli and Ulvi Mammadov at Mingachevir State University compile municipal-waste generation and collection projections for Azerbaijan's waste-management planning regions. The tables cover 2022, 2029 and 2036 and include generation, collection, collection rates, uncollected waste and derived growth measures. The authors identify published planning information and the national waste-management strategy as the underlying sources. Zenodo provides CSV and Excel files, a data dictionary, regional summary and source list under CC BY 4.0, free of charge. These projections can supply regional demand scenarios for collection and treatment capacity models. They are planning estimates, not measured annual flows. The planning regions also differ from current official economic regions, so geographical joins require care. No missing values were interpolated according to the deposit. No direct link to an existing catalogue record is documented.
